Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Fincher
Analyst: Vee Mosely
Date: 02/10/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 265 as introduced will increase the state-paid salary of all registrars in the state from $80 per day, currently, to $100 per day, which would increase the obligations of the State General Fund by an estimated maximum of $791,000 annually.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund
